name: Christian Identity
summary: Christian Identity is a loose network of White-supremacist churches and ministries that reads the Bible as saying Whites (Anglo-Saxon, Germanic and kindred peoples) are the literal Israel and God's chosen race. Most adherents hold that non-Whites are a lesser or separate creation, that Jews descend from Satan and conspire to rule the world, and that race-mixing is sin. They look to an imminent race war and to a society governed by their reading of God's law.
scope: The post-1940s American Identity movement of Wesley Swift, Bertrand Comparet, Kingdom Identity Ministries and the Aryan Nations churches. It excludes the original, non-racist British Israelism and the Christian Patriot tax-protest strand where that is not shared by Identity as a whole. Identity has no central creed, so strand splits (such as on violence) are answered as splits.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Identity holds that non-Whites are a separate, lesser creation and that the races should not share authority or society, so it denies equal worth and equal standing.

divinely-chosen-superior-people.rationale: Identity's defining claim is that the White race is God's chosen, literal Israel, placed above all other peoples; Swift, Comparet and the Kingdom Identity Ministries creed all say so.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Identity teaches that Jews, as Satan's seed, conspire to dominate government, finance, education and media against the Christian White nations.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Kingdom Identity Ministries' flyer 'God Commands Racial Separation' calls race-mixing a sin and 'the worst form of genocide'.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: The KIM flyers demand racial separation and condemn integration of schools and churches as sin, though they argue from divine command rather than drafting a statute.

racial-franchise.rationale: KIM holds it a sin to put people of another race in authority over Whites, and the Identity-linked Republic v. Democracy group says only Whites can and should be citizens.

ethnic-nation.rationale: The Aryan Nations programme aims at an all-White homeland in the Northwest, and Identity treats integration as the ruin of White nations.

race-based-immigration-restrictions.rationale: The KIM flyer says America is invaded by alien races that cannot be assimilated, which calls for excluding them by race.

reduce-immigration.rationale: KIM literature describes immigration of non-White peoples as an invasion to be stopped.

open-borders.rationale: KIM literature treats immigration by 'alien races' as an invasion, which contradicts open borders.

elite-replacement.rationale: Preacher Charles Weisman, quoted in the Encyclopedia of Race and Racism, says Jews promote multi-racial immigration to destroy the White race.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: KIM says multi-culturalism destroys the Christian way of life and that integration brought ruin to every White nation.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Identity treats races as separate creations and says non-Whites lack the capacity to grasp Christian civilization, which asserts inborn difference.

race-social-construct.rationale: Identity's tenets hold that non-Aryans are a different species from Whites, so race is not a social construct.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: KIM's creed calls the White seedline far superior to all other peoples, and its flyer says non-Whites cannot understand Christian civilization.

racial-pride.rationale: Identity makes the White race God's chosen people and treats race as a sacred inheritance, so pride in it is a duty.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Comparet argues that Jews are not Semitic or true Israelites, and condemns 'Jewish seizure of Palestine'.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Swift calls the United Nations run by the devil and urges its folding up, and Watchman reports Identity regards the UN as a Jewish puppet.

defeat-communism.rationale: Swift tells his hearers that smashing Communism and its masters is their job, and Comparet frames Communism as part of the enemy's plan.

political-violence-never.rationale: Identity divides: Butler publicly frowns on proactive violence and Gayman preaches non-violence, while Phineas Priests justify killing.

more-religion-public.rationale: Swift tells his congregation this is a Christian nation and to elect Christians to high office.

separate-church-state.rationale: Swift insists the nation is Christian and should be governed by Christians, and KIM urges obedience to God's laws in public life.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: KIM flyers argue public policy from the Laws of God, and Megiddo says adherents punish violators of God's law as found in the Bible.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Identity casts politics as war between God's White race and Satan's Jewish seedline, climaxing in Armageddon.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its rationale is about one government, party or regime, or about fighting corruption, not a general claim that most politicians put their own interests first, which this statement now asks.

reviewHistory.rationale: Watchman reports Identity holds the US government to be controlled by an anti-Christ Jewish conspiracy.

population-transfer.rationale: Abanes reports that the debate among followers is over removing non-Whites by export or extermination, and Gerald L. K. Smith urged shipping Black people to Africa.

notes: Identity has no central authority, so strands differ on violence and on removal versus extermination of non-Whites. Economic and constitutional positions (usury, Federal Reserve, tax protest, Posse Comitatus) belong to the overlapping Christian Patriot strand and are left null. The library has no source on Holocaust denial, criminal law on homosexuality or abortion law, so those are null. Themes searched: race, religion, immigration, world, government, economy, liberty.

authors.quote: This doctrine was noted in Bertrand Comparet’s The Cain-Satanic Seed Line
